t: The Flomasta Straight Flexible Hose provides reliable plumbing connections for various water systems. This 1/2" x 1/2" x 500mm flexible hose is ideal for connecting water supplies in kitchens and bathrooms, suitable for professional plumbers and general builders. Featuring a 10mm bore and a lightweight, kink-free polymer braid, it offers excellent corrosion and heat resistance, ensuring sustained functionality and a clean appearance. The hose maintains flexibility across hot and cold water temperatures and prevents bio-film growth, making it suitable for drinking water installations. It is compatible with both copper and plastic pipes. Operating temperature 70ºC (90º tested).
